their_evidence: Making Friends and Influencing People (S2#3): Bakshi 'accuses her of lying' and grills her about not reporting that she knew the subject of Project Blizzard, asking if she is loyal to Hydra; he later feeds her lines on the ship, and Skye fakes a shot at Bakshi so Simmons can pretend to save him. 'Never suspects' is false: he suspects her in this very episode (and hunts her as the mole in S2#5).

Academy... was forced to do inventory work for Mackenzie' (Hunter page, ref AoS203; also the episode plot: 'Alphonso Mackenzie and Lance Hunter show up, Hunter questions Skye's credibility'). their_evidence: In A Fractured House (S2#6) their only exchange is Mack telling Simmons he does not remember the old Fitz, only knows this one, and feels this one is better without her; she tearfully agrees.
